description: Search the library of public-domain classics. mode keyword (default) matches the words you give. mode meaning finds passages by what they are about, even when the words differ. Each hit names its work, author, year and a canon-status label. Scripture is not searched here. By default only commentaries and creeds are searched; pass scope to include Church Fathers, Apocrypha or other ancient writings.

query.description: Words or a question to search for.

scope.description: Kinds of writing to search. Defaults to commentary and confession.

name: search_library
title: Search library
